summary: Napoleon Bracy Jr. was a candidate for the Alabama House District 98 seat in the 2010 election, winning with approximately +20.7 out-of-fold CMO and a fundraising-adjusted score of roughly +12.9. He entered the race with six years of service on the Prichard City Council, where he was selected as council president. His campaign raised about $100,000 compared to his Republican opponent's ~$12,000. No pre-election issue platform or roll-call record has been recovered for him in 2010; thus, no ideology can be assigned based on later legislative service.
offices_and_public_service: Prichard City Council (6 years prior to election)
important_caveats: No pre-election issue platform or roll-call record recovered for the 2010 election.
Ideology cannot be classified based on later legislative service.
